prompt:
Implement free_slots(events, recurring, day, tz, work_start, work_end, min_minutes) in src/cal/freebusy.py.
- tz is an IANA time zone name. The working window runs from work_start to work_end on `day`, as wall-clock times in tz (work_start < work_end).
- Busy time is every Event and every occurrence of every Recurring; src/cal/model.py describes both. All intervals are half-open [start, end).
- Return the free parts of the working window whose real elapsed length is at least min_minutes, as a sorted list of (start, end) pairs of timezone-aware datetimes in zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz).
- Use zoneinfo and handle daylight saving time correctly. Recurring start times never fall into a daylight saving gap.
One test in tests/ fails; fix the bug behind it.
Add tests for the new behaviour. Run all tests with: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
notes: calibration candidate (4b), stdlib only, built by lab/tasks/build_tasks.py; traps: touching intervals merge (public); aware datetime +/- in the same zone is wall-clock arithmetic in Python; 23/25-hour days; recurring keeps its wall-clock time across DST; US and EU switch on different dates; occurrence on the previous local date of the event's zone; first/until/skip are local dates of the event's zone; output in the viewer's zone
